component {

    function run() {
        var x = [ 1, 2, 3 ];
        var s = { 'a' = 1, 'b' = 2, 'd' = 3 };
        [ a, , c ] = x;
        [ a, ...r ] = x;
        ( { a, b: c, d = 1 } = s );
        var { a: va, b: [ vb ] = [ 2 ] } = { 'a' = 1 };
        literal = { 'a' = 1, 'b' = [ 2, 3 ], 'c' = { }, 'd' = [ ] };
        writeOutput( a & c & d & va & vb & arrayLen( r ) & structCount( literal ) );
        writeOutput( sole( { 'a' = 1 } ) & commented( { 'a' = 1, 'b' = 2 } ) & empty( { } ) );
    }

    function sole( { a, b = 2 } ) {
        return a + b;
    }

    function commented( {
        a, // the first
        b
    } ) {
        return a + b;
    }

    function empty( { } ) {
        return 1;
    }

}
